messages:
kevin: Heads-up — I'm proposing a small UX + API change for runtime config rollouts: add a `simulate` (dry-run that emits telemetry but doesn't change routing) mode in the Console and API so product/platform teams can validate effects before activation.

tara: Love this. Two quick asks: 1) how do we represent partial rollout targets (cohorts) in simulate? 2) telemetry needs to be labeled so it doesn't pollute SLO dashboards.

kevin: For cohorts we'd reuse the existing cohort hash but add `simulate_target=true` in the payload. Telemetry will include `simulation_id` and `simulated=true` tags.

omar: Example request? can you paste the body we'd accept from SDKs?

kevin:
```
POST /api/v1/configs/activate
{
  "config_id": "route-quota-v3",
  "rollout": {"type":"cohort","percentage":5},
  "mode": "simulate",
  "simulation_id": "sim-2026-03-21-01"
}
```

jess: Will simulate mode allow KV cache priming and batching to run so we can measure latency/costs?

kevin: Yes — simulation will go through the same runtime path except we short-circuit state writes and quotas. So cache/KV updates are in-memory ephemeral for the run.

config-bot: note: Simulation runs will be rate-limited to 10 qps per-config per-org to avoid noisy neighbour effects. :robot_face: 

tara: Important: we need an opt-out toggle so endpoint dashboards can ignore simulated traffic by default.

lina: From observability side: we can add a `simulation` checkbox on the route detail page to toggle simulated traces. We'll need a stable tag to filter across traces, logs, metrics.

kevin: Agreed. Plan:
- API: add `mode: simulate|dry_run|active` (backwards compatible default `active`)
- Console: activate checkbox + show simulation telemetry panel
- Runtime: emit `simulated=true` tag on metrics/traces, skip state writes
- Quotas: report simulated usage in separate metric `tokens.simulated` not in billable metrics

omar: How do we handle downstream webhooks/third-party integrations during simulate? Could accidentally trigger things.

kevin: Good catch. We'll add a safety: any side-effecting actions are suppressed unless `allow_side_effects=true` is explicitly set and org admin approved. Default is false.

jess: Does this need an RFC? I can draft one — include telemetry schema, API contract, console mockups, and ops runbook for reverting simulations.

kevin: Please — that’d be great. Also need a short-lived retention policy on simulation telemetry (default 7 days) per compliance.

lina: We'll add a sampling flag to avoid full-fidelity traces for high-volume sims. Ops: please don't run huge wide sims without coordination. :warning: 

tara: tagging product managers for awareness @amanda @ryan

kevin: thanks — I'll open the RFC and a small prototype branch. If folks are ok, I'll schedule a 30m sync later this week. :thumbsup:
